high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post featuring two individuals dressed in traditional Indian attire. The person on the right is a man dressed in a cream-colored kurta with intricate embroidery along the neckline and sleeves, paired with white pants. He is also holding a piece of fabric or clothing.
